title: Berberine inhibits protein citrullination of fibroblast-like synoviocytes by suppressing autophagy via STAT3/PAD4 pathway.
authors: Song, Yi-Ning; Zhang, Fan; He, Yun; Li, Yu-Hui; Hu, Fang-Yan; Gao, Yi; Zong, Shi-Ye; Wang, Ying; Gao, Xiao-Yu; Tang, Qian; Jiang, Xin-Meng; Tong, Fang-Zhou; Yan, Li-Ping; Wei, Fang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过STAT3/PAD4通路抑制类风湿关节炎滑膜细胞自噬与蛋白瓜氨酸化，虽涉及STAT3与PADI4启动子结合的ChIP实验，但核心是药物机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，且方法以湿实验为主，仅分子对接为辅助，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nearly 50% of patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) fail to respond adequately to current therapies within a clinically effective timeframe. Previous studies have demonstrated that berberine (BBR) exerts therapeutic effects in RA, however, neither its targets nor associated mechanisms have been investigated. PURPOSE: To identify the direct BBR target and elucidate its molecular mechanism in RA. METHODS: The BBR effects on autophagy and protein citrullination were evaluated using MH7A cells and rats with adjuvant-induced arthritis (AA). Network pharmacology was employed to predict potential BBR target genes in RA. Molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), solvent-induced protein precipitation (SIP), and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) were conducted to confirm target binding. Western blotting, transmission electron microscopy, immunofluorescence co-localization, chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP), dual-luciferase reporter assays, and qRT-PCR were performed to investigate the molecular pathways involved. RESULTS: BBR reduced citrullinated protein levels by suppressing autophagy in MH7A cells. Network pharmacology suggested STAT3 as a potential BBR target. Molecular docking, CETSA, SIP, and SPR confirmed binding between BBR and STAT3. In AA rats, BBR treatment significantly lowered serum ACPA levels and decreased the levels of cVIM, citH3, p-STAT3, PAD4, and autophagy markers in AA-FLSs. Mechanistic studies show that STAT3 might directly binds to the PADI4 promoter, promoting its transcription. STAT3 activation or overexpression prevented PAD4 inhibition by BBR, impaired its regulation of p-mTOR, and enhanced autophagy and protein citrullination. On the other hand, PAD4 inhibition enhanced the suppressive effects of BBR on PAD4, autophagy, and protein citrullination without affecting p-STAT3 levels. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that BBR alleviates RA and reduces citrullinated protein production by inhibiting autophagy through STAT3/PAD4 pathway. These findings provide novel mechanistic insight and identify STAT3 as a direct molecular target of BBR in RA.
abstract_zh: 背景：近50%的类风湿关节炎（RA）患者未能在临床有效时间窗内对现有疗法产生充分应答。既往研究表明，小檗碱（BBR）在RA中发挥治疗作用，但其靶点及相关机制尚未被探究。目的：鉴定BBR的直接靶点，并阐明其在RA中的分子机制。方法：使用MH7A细胞和佐剂诱导性关节炎（AA）大鼠评估BBR对自噬和蛋白质瓜氨酸化的影响。采用网络药理学预测RA中潜在的BBR靶基因。通过分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、溶剂诱导蛋白沉淀（SIP）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）确认靶点结合。采用Western blotting、透射电子显微镜、免疫荧光共定位、染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）、双荧光素酶报告基因实验和qRT-PCR研究涉及的分子通路。结果：BBR通过抑制MH7A细胞中的自噬降低瓜氨酸化蛋白水平。网络药理学提示STAT3为BBR的潜在靶点。分子对接、CETSA、SIP和SPR确认了BBR与STAT3之间的结合。在AA大鼠中，BBR治疗显著降低血清ACPA水平，并降低AA-FLSs中cVIM、citH3、p-STAT3、PAD4和自噬标志物的水平。机制研究表明，STAT3可能直接结合PADI4启动子，促进其转录。STAT3激活或过表达阻止了BBR对PAD4的抑制，损害其对p-mTOR的调控，并增强自噬和蛋白质瓜氨酸化。另一方面，PAD4抑制增强了BBR对PAD4、自噬和蛋白质瓜氨酸化的抑制作用，而不影响p-STAT3水平。结论：本研究证明，BBR通过STAT3/PAD4通路抑制自噬，从而缓解RA并减少瓜氨酸化蛋白的产生。这些发现提供了新的机制见解，并确定STAT3为BBR在RA中的直接分子靶点。
